lede: Alabama carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.8 against +1.7, a 1.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Alabama -22.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 93% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Florida State leads Alabama by 50 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
